source_candidate.exact_claim: AblateCell first reproduces reported baselines end-to-end by auto-configuring environments, resolving dependency/data issues, rerunning official evaluations and emitting artifacts; it then performs closed-loop isolated ablations. On CPA, GEARS and BioLORD it reports 88.9% end-to-end workflow success (+29.9 percentage points versus a human-expert baseline) and 93.3% accuracy recovering ground-truth critical components (+53.3 percentage points versus a heuristic baseline).

primary_verification.primary_artifact: AblateCell: A Reproduce-then-Ablate Agent for Virtual Cell Repositories, arXiv v2 abstract/record
primary_verification.exact_checked_scope: arXiv v2 landing-page metadata and abstract only; no PDF methods/tables, source archive, code, raw outputs, evaluator labels or independent rerun were inspected in this bounded slice
primary_verification.tested_scope: source-statement verification only; no execution or reproduction
evidence_summary: The primary arXiv abstract states that AblateCell first reproduces reported baselines end-to-end by auto-configuring environments, resolving dependency and data issues, rerunning official evaluations, and emitting verifiable artifacts.

The abstract states that it then performs closed-loop ablation by generating isolated repository mutations and adaptively selecting experiments under a performance-impact versus execution-cost reward.

The abstract identifies the evaluated repositories as CPA, GEARS and BioLORD and reports 88.9% end-to-end workflow success, +29.9% to human expert, plus 93.3% accuracy recovering ground-truth critical components, +53.3% to heuristic.
gaps_or_contradictions: No contradiction was found between the worker's quoted system-level design/results and the arXiv v2 abstract.
The abstract does not establish that reproduce-first alone causally causes the reported gains; it reports the integrated reproduce-then-ablate system.

This slice does not verify definitions of workflow success or ground-truth critical components, per-repository denominators, statistical uncertainty, human/heuristic baseline protocols, artifact completeness, code availability, or independent reproducibility.
The evidence is confined to three computational single-cell perturbation repositories and does not establish transfer to wet-lab or general autonomous-science settings.
primary_verification.claim_limits: Accept only the primary-source attribution that the paper reports the stated reproduce-then-ablate design and aggregate metrics. Do not promote this as evidence that the reproduce-first gate itself has a matched causal ablation, that the metrics independently reproduce, or that the mechanism generalizes beyond the reported virtual-cell repository setting.
